proposal.expected_benefit: This will reduce the risk of adversarial exploitation by ensuring that emergency stops are only triggered in legitimate scenarios, thereby preserving system integrity and preventing unnecessary disruptions.
proposal.problem: The system's existing emergency stop mechanisms may not effectively distinguish between legitimate and adversarial triggers, creating a potential vulnerability.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a mechanism to differentiate between legitimate and adversarial emergency stop triggers, ensuring that only authorized and contextually valid emergency stops are executed.
proposal.title: Clarify Emergency Stop Differentiation
verification_tests: Validate emergency stop differentiation logic under adversarial conditions
Test system behavior when both legitimate and adversarial emergency stops are simulated
